description: Checks a publicly accessible website for AI-agent readiness and GEO: can AI agents reach, read, understand and act on it? Fetches the site the way agents do (GET only, no login, no changes) and scores five weighted areas: access 30, understanding 25, discoverability 20, EU transparency and privacy signals 15, actionability 10. Returns the overall score, area scores, the three findings with the most impact, every single check, known limits and a link to the full report. Each top finding carries evidence, a next step and, where one fits, a Blck Alpaca Knowledge Base guide that explains the fix. Checks on young standards such as llms.txt are bonus only: they add at most 5 points, and missing them costs nothing. Check texts are in German. Not a legal assessment. Scoring model and every check documented at https://blckalpaca.at/en/agentic-check#methodik
